title: Multi Biomes Compatibility
description: You don't know which world gen datapack to use? With this datapack, you can use several biomes datapack in a single world, making most of the biomes datapacks (up to 8) compatible
body:
# Multi biomes compatibility

/!\ This datapack is experimental
This datapack will make biomes datapacks compatible together, extending the world's biomes to a high amount!

## How does it work
The datapack will automatically enable the "0.zip" datapack first, and 30 minutes later, disable it & enable "1.zip" datapack, and so on, up to 8.zip, then it will go back to 0.zip
On each restart, the world gen of unexplored chunks will be different

-> **It allows the map to have a lot of different biomes on a single map, and the generation only affects new chunks!**

-> The color of foliage, water etc will switch every 30 minutes if a datapack uses a different setting

-> If your datapack adds new biomes, their ID will be replaced at some points, which is why the datapack only work for datapack **replacing** vanilla biomes, **not adding**

### What you need to know
- You can use up to 8 biomes datapacks at the same time
- Rename each biome datapacks ZIP file to "0.zip", "1.zip"... "8.zip"

## Performance Impact
Light!
